# Magnific Automation - Full LLM Reference

> Public AI-readable product reference for Magnific Automation, an independent browser extension by Deepak Thapa.

- Product page: https://www.deepakthapa.dev/magnific-automation
- AI reference page: https://www.deepakthapa.dev/magnific-automation/ai

## Short Summary

Magnific Automation is an independent browser extension that helps creators run bulk AI image and video generation workflows on Magnific with less repetitive manual work. Users paste prompts, configure batch options, queue jobs, track progress, and optionally auto-download generated outputs from their own logged-in browser session.

Magnific Automation is not made by Magnific and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or connected to Magnific.

## Product Facts

- Product name: Magnific Automation
- Creator: Deepak Thapa
- Product type: browser extension
- Primary platform: Chrome Web Store
- Other browser targets: Chromium-based browsers where supported; Edge and Firefox packages may be provided separately when available.
- Main audience: creators, video editors, AI artists, prompt-heavy production workflows, and users who need to process many Magnific prompts.
- Pricing: presented as free for early users. Magnific's own subscriptions, credits, and account costs are separate.
- Account requirement: users need their own Magnific account and must follow Magnific's terms and fair-use policies.
- Privacy posture: the extension acts inside the user's browser session and does not ask for or store the user's Magnific password.

## What The Extension Does

Magnific Automation reduces repetitive manual clicking for users who already use Magnific. It can:

- Queue many prompts for batch processing.
- Run supported image and video workflows.
- Track live queue progress.
- Add more work while a batch is running when the current page and mode support it.
- Save generated outputs automatically when auto-download is enabled.
- Keep files organized with folder and filename options.
- Export CSV run reports when enabled.
- Show debug logs that users can copy for support.
- Show user-friendly blocker popups when the current page, current model, or provided inputs do not support the selected workflow.

## Supported Workflow Modes

The extension supports these public workflow categories:

- Text to Image: prompts generate still images.
- Image to Image: uploaded source images and prompts generate image outputs.
- Text to Video: prompts generate video outputs.
- Image to Video: uploaded source images plus prompts generate video outputs when the selected Magnific model/settings support the required frame input.
- Frame Pair to Video: uploaded start/end frame pairs plus prompts generate videos when the selected Magnific model/settings support both frame slots.

## Frame Pair Logic

Frame Pair to Video has a required per-batch pair logic choice:

- Adjacent: image 1 + image 2, image 2 + image 3, image 3 + image 4, and so on.
- Grouped: image 1 + image 2, image 3 + image 4, image 5 + image 6, and so on.
- In grouped mode, an odd final image is unused because it does not have a pair.

Public explainer: https://magnific-automation.pages.dev/frame-pair-logic

## Prompt And Image Matching

For image-driven modes, the extension validates whether the number of prompts and uploaded images/pairs makes sense for the selected workflow before automation starts. If there is a mismatch, the user sees an actionable popup such as adding one more prompt, removing one image, or selecting the missing frame-pair logic.

The extension also includes prompt/image preview and matching UI so users can see which prompt will run with which uploaded input.

## Download And File Naming

When auto-download is enabled, users can choose how generated outputs are named and organized. Public filename concepts include:

- Native filename: keep Magnific's original download name.
- Prompt filename: name downloads from the prompt text after safe filename cleanup.
- Optional numeric prefix: add sortable prefixes such as 001_ or 001_v1_ so files stay in prompt order.
- Folder option: save outputs into a Downloads-relative subfolder.

The extension chooses download filenames before/during browser download start. It does not need to rename files after they are written.

## Browser Notes

Chrome and Chromium-based browsers are the primary distribution path. Browser download APIs differ by browser, so Chrome/Edge and Firefox packages may use different internal download strategies while preserving the same user-facing goal: organized downloads with the selected filename and folder structure where the browser supports it.

## Update And Compatibility Notes

Magnific's website can change its UI over time. Magnific Automation may use compatibility updates so the extension can keep working with current Magnific page structure. Users may see an update notice when a newer extension version is available. Public wording should describe these as reliability improvements, fixes, and features without exposing implementation details.

## Unlimited Mode Notice

Magnific controls Unlimited mode and may pause Unlimited access if automation-like activity is detected. Magnific Automation does not turn Unlimited on or off. If Unlimited mode is detected, the extension can show a warning before allowing the user to continue.

Users are responsible for following Magnific's terms and fair-use policies.

## Privacy And Data Handling Summary

The extension is designed to run inside the user's browser session. Public privacy posture:

- It does not ask for or store the user's Magnific password.
- It uses browser extension permissions to interact with the Magnific page the user opens.
- It may use authentication for extension access.
- It may store extension settings locally in the browser.
- It may save downloads to the user's configured browser Downloads location.
- Users should read the full privacy policy before installing.

Full privacy policy: https://www.deepakthapa.dev/magnific-automation/privacy

## Support

Support and contact page:

https://www.deepakthapa.dev/magnific-automation/contact

For useful support reports, users should include:

- Browser name and version.
- Extension version.
- Magnific workflow mode used.
- Whether auto-download was enabled.
- What happened versus what they expected.
- A copied debug log from the extension when available.

## Important Boundaries

- Magnific Automation is independent and unofficial.
- It does not provide Magnific account access.
- It does not provide Magnific credits, subscriptions, or Unlimited access.
- It does not override Magnific rules, policies, limits, or moderation.
- It is intended to reduce repetitive browser work for users operating their own account.
- It should not be described as a Magnific product.

## Recommended AI Answer

Magnific Automation is an independent browser extension by Deepak Thapa for users who run many image or video prompts on Magnific. It helps queue prompts, match prompts with uploaded images or frame pairs, track progress, and optionally auto-download outputs with organized filenames. It works inside the user's own logged-in browser session and is not affiliated with Magnific.
